brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / editorial sports illustration.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball article thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1600 x 900 pixels or larger. A premium hand-drawn ink and dry-brush sports poster, unmistakably an illustration, never photorealistic.

Style reference already inspected: approved B-culver-black-lime-v3.png. Match its charcoal black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B brush streaks, ivory heavy Japanese headline, expressive black-and-white ink hatching, restrained orange basketball. Do NOT copy its old player, name, date, score, or statistics.

Layout: left 57 percent clean typography, right 43 percent one large real basketball player in a dynamic three-quarter pose. Strong diagonal brush energy behind the athlete; few elements; generous safe margins. Editorial, muscular, energetic. No inset photos, no extra people, no logo, no sponsor marks.

Real person: Josh Hawkinson (ジョシュ・ホーキンソン), selected at random from the ten players in the supplied article, NOT a fictional generic player. His official Tokyo Sunrockers 2026-27 profile and portrait were visually checked. Preserve these observed features in illustrative linework: very tall broad-shouldered athletic build, fair skin, short dark-brown hair with closely cropped sides and longer top swept back with a side part, high forehead, slightly long oval-square face, strong angular jaw and chin, straight prominent nose, thin lips, light blue-gray eyes under dark eyebrows, visible ears, nearly clean-shaven with only very light stubble. Do not give him a full beard, curly hair, or a different face. Face should be clearly visible in three-quarter view, focused eyes looking toward the imagined passing direction.
Action: an imagined powerful rebound-to-outlet pivot, torso twisting, holding ONE basketball firmly with both hands around upper-chest height, elbows naturally bent, shoulders active. Frame from above his head to upper thighs. Both hands, their fingers, the ball and face remain completely within the image and do not overlap the text. Anatomically coherent two arms, two natural hands. This is an illustrative pose, NOT a recreation of an actual game moment. Plain unbranded ivory basketball jersey with black shadows and subtle lime trim; plain shorts, dark right-elbow sleeve. No player name, number, team lettering or logos on clothing. Do not paste or reproduce the official photos.

Exact visible typography only, all in Japanese gothic heavy display type where appropriate, sharp and perfectly legible:
Small top-left masthead: "バスケまとめ"
Small date / competition line: "2026.11.10  B.PREMIER"
Large ivory headline: "登録選手の"
Largest lime headline immediately below: "ベスト5"
Smaller ivory explanatory lines: "対象試合の登録選手から"
"今季平均EFFで選出"
Clear high-contrast qualification strip below: "試合前｜出場確定ではありません"
Small but readable footer: "イラスト（AI生成）・イメージ"

Text meaning must remain precise: these are pre-game selections among the registered players of that day's scheduled matchups based on season-average EFF, not a league-wide overall ranking, not confirmed appearances, not game results. No player name, personal statistics, points, records, victory claims or appearance claims anywhere. Do not add any other words or numerals. The random featured player's illustration merely provides the basketball visual; the headline describes the article's selection method. Maintain the explicit AI label and image disclaimer. Keep every glyph and all key anatomy inside generous 5 percent safe margins.
